capabilities: upload pasted clipboard images to imgur.com
upload images dragged from the file system, including animated gifs
embed the uploaded remote image into the note
upload anonymously or to a connected Imgur account
extras: Every user must create their own Imgur Client ID to avoid shared daily rate limits. On failed uploads (e.g. CORS errors) it falls back to storing the image locally; anonymous uploads cannot be deleted afterwards; video upload is not supported.
motivation: The author thinks Obsidian's fully-local storage 'can be improved for images' because frequent image pasting grows the vault and backup size.
problem: Pasting many images bloats the local vault, which slows or costs more when syncing or backing up notes via git or cloud storage.
summary: Image uploader that sends pasted or dragged images to imgur.com and embeds the remote image in the note instead of storing it in the vault.
